setup: if ! command -v cc >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config; elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config; else echo 'A C compiler is required but neither root nor sudo is available.' >&2; exit 1; fi; else echo 'A C compiler is required to build opake-accounting, but no supported package manager is available.' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi
if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y; fi
